# openporch_current_user (Data Source)

The user the provider's token belongs to, and their organization role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openporch_current_user" "me" {}

output "user" {
  value = data.openporch_current_user.me.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The user ID.
- `name` (String) The display name.
- `role` (String) The organization role, empty when the user has none.
- `type` (String) `human` or `service`.
